statement: Run the data operation "Convert Volume" on the current selection in world and environment settings; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Create new content in world and environment settings with "New World"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
